professor.why: Chapter-by-chapter cartoon explanations make discipline traps and practical fixes accessible to a psychology-curious audience, though the encyclopedic tone is less personal than this self-improvement topic invites.
titles: 7 Discipline Traps And Their Fixes Explained
Common Discipline Mistakes And Simple Fixes Explained
Why Discipline Fails: 8 Common Causes Explained

stickman.why: Second-person storytelling, emotional close-ups, and numbered takeaways perfectly fit a self-improvement audience looking for relatable struggles and small, actionable fixes.
titles: 7 Small Fixes That Help You Stay Disciplined
Why You Keep Giving Up (And How To Break The Cycle)
Stop Relying On Motivation If You Want To Stay Disciplined
